text:
jess: Drafted a 1-pager that combines SLAs, deploy-mode quick-decider, and a 3-benchmark snapshot. Link: https://drive.redwood/launch/enterprise-pocket_v1

omar: Nice. Can we make the SLA table scannable for AE calls? i.e., 3 columns: mode, 99th latency (seq<=512), monthly SLO uptime.

tess: yes, and add a tiny fallback example showing Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private with auto-failover for spikes. Keep it a single-row flowchart emoji style.

ryan: For inbound routing, I'm proposing simple rules so SDRs don't get noise: tag by industry and by deploy interest. Sample: fintech + private => route to solutions-enterprise, ciso tag.

jess: added a short rule set in the doc. Also added three outbound subject lines tailored to audiences: "Predictable LLM economics for regulated teams", "Enterprise SLAs for inference at scale", "Private connect + verifiable audit logs". Which flows best for field?

omar: Field wants a one-liner for CISO and one for platform lead. CISO: short compliance + audit logs. Platform: latency predictability and cost controls.

tess: Webinar plan: 25m bench storytelling + 20m customer readiness checklist + 15m live Q&A + 5m CTAs. We should slot runtime eng and a solutions SE for the checklist.

ryan: agree. Also add a two-slide demo: 90s of failover routing and 90s of latency/cost dashboard. Helps show ops confidence.

design-bot: design task created: /tasks/2387 onepager_v1 -> onepager_v1a. ETA EOD. Will export PNG for slides.

jess: Added short bench bullets (3 runs): median token latency, cost/token, tail latency 99th. Keep numbers rounded for field (e.g., ~45ms median, 200ms 99th on hosted baseline).

omar: make sure notes call out quantization and batching knobs that affect numbers. Field needs to know options.

tess: demo script draft: "Show request hitting hosted, spike causes autoscaler delay, routing moves to dedicated, private remains for compliance-sensitive flows." Can someone tidy into a 6-line script?

jess: I'll tidy. Also added inbound lead priority flags: pilot|poC|rfp plus a recommended AE SLA (24h for pilot).

ops-bot: release-bot: assets built: onepager_v1a.pdf (hash: ef34ab), slides_deck_v0.2.pptx (hash: 9c11fd).

jess: Final ask: review drive doc comments by 3pm PT. If thumbs up, we'll schedule the webinar draft and seed invites to top 50 inbound leads. :rocket:
